brief:
Drop Site News reported that the Palestinian Football Association has restarted its leagues following a three-year suspension during the conflict. The competition, branded the Thousand Martyrs Cup, marks the first organized domestic football season since the war began.

Players and coaches are navigating the resumption with conflicting emotions as matches resume across Palestinian territories. Participants have expressed both despair over the losses sustained during the conflict and determination to rebuild community life through sport. The return of organized football signals an attempt to restore normalcy in daily life amid ongoing humanitarian challenges.
dek: The resumption of the Palestinian Football Association's leagues is being met by players and coaches with a mix of despair and resilience.
title: Palestinian football resumes after three-year war hiatus
